description: A protocol-relative CDN stylesheet on a host that refuses connections: critical tries https then http and silently drops it.

thin.note: A failed stylesheet on another host (CDN / third party) is skipped with one logSafe'd warning and the job succeeds. (In these fixtures {{site}} and {{cdn}} share the hostname 127.0.0.1 and differ only by port: "same host" must compare host:port, as the url() rebasing does, or be injectable.)
